result.reason: 用户hat-wish明确要收到漫画，最近一篇已有三格漫画仍尊重本次明确请求，用四格试帽动作因果承接新的穿戴故事。漫画是宠物做给用户的物件，Avatar另由appearance更新，家只有收藏的小补充。

carrier.purpose: 把第一次叶片滴眼睛、改造帽檐、试雨与戴成帽的结果交给用户
carrier.viewpoint: 小蟹把自己的试帽过程画成漫画，四格依其经历排序；不冒充自拍

form.background: 每格不透明的石窝门前环境，暖白纸与宽格间留白
form.border: 四格统一细深色边框，整体外缘纸边

mustShow: 第一格平叶朝眼柄滴水
第二格在旧壳门下用钳折出两侧外翻宽檐
第三格两颗门边蓝石之间测试，水滴从两侧檐端落下、眼柄下清楚可见
第四格戴同一完成叶帽，圆左钳举向帽檐、尖右钳靠体旁
奶白双青绿弧纹成年蟹身份每格持续，四足、双钳与眼柄不变
无字漫画；不以孤立场景插图替代多格因果

visuals.description: 小蟹画给用户的四格试雨帽漫画
visuals.request: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE 3:2 landscape FOUR-PANEL WORDLESS cartoon pixel-art comic, on a warm cream paper sheet with clear dark thin panel frames and WIDE cream gutters. Exactly 2 columns by 2 rows, read top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right. The accepted reference is the SAME adult living fantasy crab identity: broad low cream rounded carapace, TWO curved teal bands, TWO short dark eye stalks, biological ROUND LEFT claw and slightly pointed RIGHT claw, FOUR short walking feet two per side. Preserve same compact cream/teal crab throughout all four panels. This is the crab drawing its own trial of a leaf rain hat for the user, no camera/photo framing. Same rocky shallow coastal home doorway with ONE pale cream old half eggshell shelter leaning against a grey rock and TWO small light-blue round stones at doorway. Panel 1 TOP LEFT: just outside doorway in light rain, crab wears one flat light-green broad leaf on top, its leaf tip angles DOWN toward an eye stalk and a water droplet visibly falls from this tip onto the eye stalk; crab pauses. Panel 2 TOP RIGHT: crab sheltered under old eggshell doorway, leaf OFF its body and held in its TWO biological claws, folding broad side edges outward to form a low crown and two outward rain-draining brim ends; four feet support body. No tools or scissors needed. Panel 3 BOTTOM LEFT: crab wears the now finished low pale-green leaf rain hat above front of shell, stands between the TWO doorway blue stones to test light rain. BOTH short dark eye stalks plainly visible UNDER brim; water droplets roll and fall off BOTH SIDE brim ends outside its eyes, eyes stay dry. Thin grass-fiber strap follows shell sides and leaves claws and feet free. Panel 4 BOTTOM RIGHT: SAME completed leaf hat, crab sideways walking near doorway, its ROUND LEFT claw raised to brim as if showing the fit, pointed right claw held by body, eyes clear under brim and both teal bands still visible. Clear visual progression flat-leaf dripping failure, protected folding repair, side-draining test, continued wearing. Each scene complete inside own frame, no panel overlaps. Simple crisp chunky pixel clusters and stepped edges, few flat cream/teal/pale-green/slate/tan color blocks, cute approachable living companion, no realistic anatomical textures. Entire sheet opaque, margin around all panels. NO captions, speech bubbles, question marks, exclamation marks, numerals, lettering, arrows, humans, humanoid hands, other animals or photo stamps. Not an Avatar replacement or sprite sheet.
